merits.name: Sectarian Ally
merits.summary: You maintain a useful friend in another sect and can navigate its politics through them.

merits.name: Thousand Meter Killer
merits.summary: You are a proven sniper, reducing sniping difficulty and extending rifle range.

flaws.name: Outcast
flaws.summary: You rejected your caste's role and suffer open disdain from it.

flaws.name: Broken Antitribu
flaws.summary: You joined the Sabbat but still suffer the Tremere Curse and its social cost.

flaws.name: Multiple Curses
flaws.summary: You bear an additional Assamite clan curse on top of your normal weakness.

merits.name: Fury's Focus
merits.summary: Path of Entelechy practice lets you delay frenzy briefly and soften degeneration afterward.

merits.name: Dynamic Personality
merits.summary: Your charisma draws mortals to you, easing the growth of mortal-focused Backgrounds.

flaws.name: Obvious Predator
flaws.summary: Mortals instinctively read your rage as danger and fear you for it.

merits.name: Drug Resistance
merits.summary: You resist intoxicants and can better feign being impaired.

merits.name: Addictive Blood
merits.summary: Those who taste your blood crave it obsessively afterward.

merits.name: Setite Initiate
merits.summary: Though Embraced outside the clan, you have been fully accepted into the Setite faith.

flaws.name: Scales
flaws.summary: Visible scales mark you with Set's touch and frighten those who see them.

flaws.name: Venomous Bite
flaws.summary: Your bite carries a dangerous neurotoxin that is difficult to hide or control.

merits.name: Hive-Minded
merits.summary: Your Animalism reaches insects and other creepy-crawlies as well as mammals.

merits.name: Skald
merits.summary: You recall oral history and vampiric lore with unusual precision.

merits.name: Lesser Mark of the Beast
merits.summary: You can sometimes suppress an animal feature when frenzy would mark you.

merits.name: Totemic Change
merits.summary: Each use of Beast Form can take a different animal shape.

flaws.name: Member of the Pack
flaws.summary: Your Animalism only works on one narrow kind of animal.

flaws.name: Rat in a Cage
flaws.summary: Restraint or confinement sends your anxiety spiking.

merits.name: Cannibal
merits.summary: You can eat human flesh, draw sustenance from it, and even gain blood from the meal.

merits.name: Consanguineous Resistance
merits.summary: Relatives from your mortal bloodline cannot blood bind you.

merits.name: Mortuario
merits.summary: You were Embraced after true death and bear both necromantic talent and corpse-like scars. This is the 2-point version used for most Giovanni; some bloodlines pay more.

merits.name: Sanguine Incongruity
merits.summary: You escaped the Giovanni clan weakness, though you look more corpse-like than ever.

merits.name: Court Favorite
merits.summary: You know how to sway Courts of Blood and steer their decisions.

merits.name: Eyes of Shadow
merits.summary: Your gaze chills others and strengthens Intimidation.

merits.name: Bigger Boys Came
merits.summary: You can sometimes use your contacts to cancel someone else's support network.

merits.name: Call of the Sea
merits.summary: Water and travel by sea grant you calm focus and a small edge.

merits.name: Controllable Night Sight
merits.summary: You switch extraordinary night vision on and off instead of suffering it constantly.

merits.name: Secret Stash
merits.summary: You have hidden Background resources you can reveal when the moment is right.

merits.name: Aura of Command
merits.summary: Leadership-based orders come naturally and land harder.

merits.name: King or Queen of Shadow
merits.summary: Your empathy on Humanity helps you resist degeneration more easily.

merits.name: Distracting Aura
merits.summary: Your aura is unusually hard to read even with Auspex.

merits.name: Prophetic Dreams
merits.summary: You can trade routine rest for lucid dreams that foreshadow coming events.

merits.name: Cold Read
merits.summary: Meeting someone new lets you spend Willpower to ask the Storyteller direct questions about them.

flaws.name: Paper Trail
flaws.summary: Institutional records from your mortal life can be found and exploited.

flaws.name: Stigmata
flaws.summary: Phantom wounds seep blood from your body every day.

flaws.name: Infectious
flaws.summary: Your bite leaves mortal victims temporarily deranged.

flaws.name: Overstimulated
flaws.summary: Your hyperawareness makes focused perception harder, not easier.

flaws.name: Dead Inside
flaws.summary: Numbness robs you of some Willpower rewards from roleplay.

merits.name: Foul Blood
merits.summary: Your blood is so repulsive it resists ghouling and diablerie.

merits.name: Lizard Limbs
merits.summary: You can shed an appendage to escape and regrow it later.

merits.name: Long Fingers
merits.summary: Fine manipulation and grappling come more easily to you.

merits.name: Monstrous Maw
merits.summary: Your bite is truly bestial and deals extra damage.

merits.name: Piscine
merits.summary: Water movement feels natural and becomes easier.

merits.name: Slimy
merits.summary: A slick ooze makes you hard to hold and slightly more fire-resistant.

merits.name: Spawning Pool
merits.summary: A blood-tainted vermin pool strengthens your Animalism in your home city.

merits.name: Tunnel Rat
merits.summary: You navigate known tunnels and sewers with unusual ease.

merits.name: Sleep Unseen
merits.summary: You can keep Obfuscate active through day sleep to hide your haven.

merits.name: Tough Hide
merits.summary: Your skin is unnaturally resilient against most ordinary harm.

flaws.name: Parasitic Infestation
flaws.summary: Ticks, lice, and leeches cling to you and drain blood nightly.

flaws.name: Bestial
flaws.summary: Each frenzy risks additional animal features like a Gangrel's.

flaws.name: Enemy Brood
flaws.summary: Another Nosferatu brood hunts you even through the sewers.

merits.name: Antitoxin Blood
merits.summary: You are immune to poisons and drugs, even supernatural ones.

merits.name: Brahmin
merits.summary: As one of the clan's keepers of lore or art, you can reroll key learning or expression failures.

merits.name: Kshatriya
merits.summary: Your warrior caste training restores Willpower when combat maneuvers land.

merits.name: Legerdemain
merits.summary: Physical trickery and sleight of hand are much easier for you.

merits.name: Mute Devotion
merits.summary: Animals you've influenced resist later commands from others.

merits.name: Vaishya
merits.summary: Once per session you can lean on a Background as though it were one dot higher.

merits.name: Critters
merits.summary: Animals adore you and occasionally bring you useful information or trinkets.

merits.name: Heart of Needles
merits.summary: Illusion and manipulation have hardened you against emotional control.

flaws.name: Chandala
flaws.summary: Your low-caste standing within the Ravnos marks you as socially diminished.

merits.name: Indelible
merits.summary: Body modifications after the Embrace remain until you consciously undo them.

merits.name: Impressive Restraint
merits.summary: Hunger is easier to resist around living vessels.

merits.name: Master of the Masquerade
merits.summary: You never forget the little mortal habits that make Kindred seem alive.

merits.name: Slowed Degeneration
merits.summary: Your Humanity resists the Beast better than most vampires' does.

flaws.name: Tortured Artist
flaws.summary: Praise cannot quiet your dissatisfaction with your own art or work.

flaws.name: Private Life
flaws.summary: You maintain a deep secret life that could provoke major political suspicion if exposed.

merits.name: Embraced without the Cup
merits.summary: You somehow missed or resisted the elders' blood at your induction into clan Tremere.

merits.name: Secret Society Member
merits.summary: You belong to one of the clan's hidden inner societies and can rely on its backing.

merits.name: Keys to the Library
merits.summary: You control access to a chantry library and can research its lore freely. In Lore of the Clans this merit scales with the chantry's Library rating; this app uses the 1-point floor as the selectable baseline.

merits.name: Outside Haven
merits.summary: You maintain a private haven outside chantry oversight.

merits.name: Unmarked Antitribu
merits.summary: You defected without bearing the obvious curse of a Tremere antitribu.

merits.name: Quartermaster
merits.summary: You can draw on the chantry's mundane stores when you need them.

flaws.name: Arcane Curse
flaws.summary: A magical curse or occult aberration complicates your existence. Lore of the Clans treats this as a variable-severity flaw; this app models a mid-strength 3-point curse.

merits.name: Bioluminescence
merits.summary: Vicissitude lets you create living illumination in flesh.

merits.name: Pain Tolerance
merits.summary: You shrug off lighter wound penalties through training or obsession.

merits.name: Dracon's Temperament
merits.summary: You can shift the Nature that defines you from story to story.

merits.name: Haven Affinity
merits.summary: Your primary haven strengthens you and calls you home across great distance.

merits.name: Revenant Disciplines
merits.summary: Your revenant heritage replaces normal in-clan Disciplines with your family's set.

merits.name: Promethean Clay
merits.summary: Vicissitude works on your own flesh with frightening speed and ease.

flaws.name: Unblinking
flaws.summary: Your eyes never close, making mortal social interaction more unsettling.

flaws.name: Ancestral Soil Dependence
flaws.summary: Your day sleep suffers unless you rest with soil tied to your homeland.

merits.name: Connoisseur
merits.summary: Tasting blood reveals surprising truths about the one who shed it.

merits.name: Blessed by St. Gustav
merits.summary: As a Ventrue antitribu you add Auspex as a fourth in-clan Discipline.

flaws.name: Uncommon Vitae Preference
flaws.summary: Your feeding preference is even narrower than most Ventrue restrictions.

merits.name: Personal Masquerade
merits.summary: You have convinced other vampires that you belong to a real clan instead of standing revealed as Caitiff.

flaws.name: Clan Weakness
flaws.summary: You inherited a sire's clan weakness even though the rest of the blood did not settle.

flaws.name: Fangless
flaws.summary: You never developed fangs and must feed from already-open wounds.

flaws.name: Ignorance
flaws.summary: You began unlife without anyone teaching you the basic truths of vampiric existence.

flaws.name: Bulimia
flaws.summary: Feeding often ends with you vomiting up the blood before it nourishes you.
